title: 선박투자회사법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130324:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Rule No. 1, Mar. 24, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (19) Omitted.

(20) The Enforcement Rules of the Ship Investment Company Act are partially amended as follows:

In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2 (1) and in Article 3, "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" is replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries", respectively.

(21) through (63) Omitted.
